title: add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Anya Patel
description:
Motivation: provide repeatable, production-focused quickstarts and small examples for RAG-style agents and tool-calling to reduce onboarding time for application teams. This PR adds opinionated RAG templates, a guided agent quickstart (Python + TypeScript), several tool-calling examples (search, calendar, code-exec stubs), and updates to the docs site navigation and code samples. Changes are intentionally small and focused so teams can copy examples into their repos.

What this includes: - New quickstarts: quickstarts/rag-agent-python, quickstarts/rag-agent-ts - Tool-calling examples: examples/tool-calling/search-demo, examples/tool-calling/calendar-demo, examples/tool-calling/code-exec-demo - RAG templates: docs/templates/rag/ (prompt + eval harness) - Docs site: docs/site/sidebar and reference pages for agent API and tool-calling - Small SDK example tweaks to show the new structured output helper

Checklist: - [x] Add Python quickstart with walkthrough and tests - [x] Add TS quickstart + runnable example - [x] Add minimal mock tool implementations for examples - [x] Docs site updates and navigation entries - [x] Unit + smoke tests for quickstarts - [x] CI green and content reviewed

Notes: The description and code samples intentionally use the redwood client example API surface and the new `Agent` quickstart helper introduced in ENG-4721. Examples include a simplified search tool that uses the public example dataset (no secrets). For any production integration callers should replace the mock tools with real adapters and secure credentials. See linked Linear ENG-4721 for rollout plan and follow-up tasks (canonical evals and extended telemetry).
